info.description:
The following endpoints are stateful in the Sandbox: * List All Partner Income Submissions * Create or Amend Partner Income * Retrieve Partner Income * Delete Partner Income # Send fraud prevention data HMRC monitors transactions to help protect your customers' confidential data from criminals and fraudsters.
! Warning You are required by law to submit header data for this API. This includes all associated APIs and endpoints.
[Check the data you need to send](/guides/fraud-prevention/). You can also use the [Test API](/api-documentation/docs/api/service/txm-fph-validator-api/1.0) during initial development and as part of your quality assurance checks. # Mapping APIs to Self Assessment tax return forms Some parameters in this API map to box numbers in one or more Self Assessment tax return forms. To learn more and to download this mapping information as a CSV file, go to [income-tax-mtd-changelog/mapping](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog?tab=readme-ov-file#mapping-apis-to-self-assessment-tax-return-forms) on GitHub. # Changelog You can find the changelog in the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/#readme) on GitHub. # Support * Direct reports of bugs or errors in Production or Sandbox code, or queries about HMRC business functionality (such as how a specific field is used by HMRC or why it is needed) to the [Software Development Support Team (SDST)](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/developer/support). * Send queries or feedback related to the design of the APIs (including recommended changes) using the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/issues) GitHub page. * Is this page not working properly? (opens in new tab)

get.description:
This endpoint enables you to retrieve a list of all partner income submissions. A National Insurance number and tax year must be provided.

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

|----------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                    |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found. |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful list.                      |

partnershipUtr.description: A Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) for the partnership. If you are a partner in a foreign partnership, you will not have a partnership reference, so submit your personal UTR.

partnershipName.description: The name of the partnership. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

startDate.description:
The date the individual joined the partnership during the tax year.

Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

endDate.description:
The date the individual left the partnership during the tax year.

Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

cashBasis.description: Indicates whether the partnership used cash basis (money actually received and paid out) to calculate its trading and professional income and expenses.

partnershipTrades.description: An array containing details of the partnership's trades.

tradeDescription.description: A description of the partnership trade or profession. This description must be unique for each trade reported. Validation is case-insensitive.  Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

tradingOrProfessionalProfits.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional profits.

shareOfProfitOrLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional profit or loss. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

basisAdjustment.description: If your basis period is not the same as your accounting period, enter the adjustment needed to arrive at the profit or loss for the basis period. If the adjustment needs to be taken off the profit figure, this should be negative. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

accountingAdjustment.description: The adjustment for change of accounting practice. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignTaxClaimedDeduction.description: The foreign tax claimed as deduction only if Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedProfit.description: The individual's share of the partnership's profit of the year, after all statutory adjustments have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

transitionProfitArisingThisYear.description: The amount of transition profit treated as arising in the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForwardTransitionProfit.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's amount of transition profit. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForwardAdjustedProfit.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's adjusted profit. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

profitAfterBroughtForwardLosses.description: The taxable profit remaining after deducting losses brought forward from earlier years, excluding the amount of transition profit treated as arising in the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherBusinessIncome.description: Any other business income received as a partner that was not included in the partnership accounts. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from the partnership's business for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

tradingOrProfessionalLosses.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional losses.

adjustedLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's loss of the year, after all statutory adjustments have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

currentYearLossAppliedToGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's loss set off against the individual's other income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesCarriedBack.description: The amount of loss to be carried back to previous years and set off against income or capital gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

nationalInsuranceContributions.description: Object containing details of Class 2 and Class 4 National Insurance contributions (NICs).

voluntaryClass2Nics.description: Indicate whether the individual wants to pay Class 2 NICs voluntarily to protect entitlement to certain benefits if profits are below the Small Profits Threshold.

class4Exemption.description: Indicate whether the individual is exempt from paying Class 4 NICs.

adjustmentToProfitsForClass4.description: The adjustment to the individual's profits specifically used to calculate Class 4 NICs. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

untaxedSavingsIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's untaxed savings income and related adjustments.

shareOfUkUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The individual's share of UK untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

untaxedSavingsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to UK untaxed savings income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedUkSavingsIncome.description: The total adjusted UK savings income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfForeignUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The individual's share of foreign untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignUntaxedSavingsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to foreign untaxed savings income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedForeignSavingsIncome.description: The total adjusted foreign savings income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The total amount of untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

ukPropertyIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's UK property income and related adjustments.

shareOfProfitOrLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's UK property profit or loss. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

profitOrLossAdjustment.description: The adjustment to UK property profit or loss, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of UK property losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's profits. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

currentYearLossAppliedToGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's UK property loss set off against the individual's other income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of UK property losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from the UK property business for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCosts.description: The individual's share of the partnership's residential property finance costs for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCostsBroughtFo.description: The unused residential property finance costs brought forward from earlier years. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's other untaxed UK income and related adjustments.

shareOfOtherUntaxedUkIncome.description: The individual's share of other untaxed UK income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to other untaxed UK income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's other untaxed UK income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfLoss.description: The individual's share of loss from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncomeLossAdjustment.description: The adjustment to the individual's share of loss from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of other untaxed UK income losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

offshoreFundsIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's income from offshore funds and related adjustments.

shareOfOffshoreFundsIncome.description: The individual's share of income from offshore funds. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

offshoreFundsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to income from offshore funds, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableIncome.description: The individual's share of total taxable income from offshore funds for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's other untaxed foreign income and related adjustments.

shareOfOtherUntaxedForeignIncome.description: The individual's share of other untaxed foreign income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to other untaxed foreign income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's other untaxed foreign income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfLoss.description: The individual's share of loss from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncomeLossesAdjustmen.description: The adjustment to the individual's share of loss from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of other untaxed foreign income losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCosts.description: The individual's share of the partnership's residential property finance costs for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCostsBroughtFo.description: The unused residential property finance costs brought forward from earlier years. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalUntaxedIncomeExcludingSavings.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's total untaxed income, excluding savings income.

shareOfTotalUntaxedIncomeExcludingSaving.description: The individual's share of the partnership's total untaxed income, excluding savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxedIncomeAndDividendIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's dividend income and taxed income.

shareOfDividendIncome.description: The individual's share of dividend income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

dividendIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from dividend income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalDividendIncome.description: The total amount of dividend income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxedIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from taxed income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalTaxedIncome.description: The total amount of taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfOtherTaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of other taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherTaxedIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from other taxed income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalTaxedAndUntaxedIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's total taxed and untaxed income.

shareOfTotalTaxedAndUntaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of the total taxed and untaxed income from the partnership. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxPaidAndDeductions.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's tax paid and deductions.

shareOfIncomeTaxTakenOffPartnershipIncom.description: The individual's share of income tax deducted from partnership income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfCisDeductionsByContractors.description: The individual's share of Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) deductions made by contractors. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxTakenOffTradingIncome.description: The individual's share of any tax deducted from trading income (excluding CIS deductions). The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTotalTaxTakenOff.description: The individual's share of total tax deducted. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

get.description:
This endpoint enables you to retrieve partner income.
A National Insurance number, tax year and partnership UTR must be provided.

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                       |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                    |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found. |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful retrieve.                  |

parameters.description: National Insurance number, in the format `AA999999A`
parameters.name: nino

parameters.description:
The tax year to which the data applies. The start year and end year must not span two tax years.
The minimum tax year is 2026-27. No gaps are allowed, for example, 2026-28 is not valid.
parameters.name: taxYear

parameters.description:
A Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) for the partnership. If you are a partner in a foreign partnership, you will not have a partnership reference, so submit your personal UTR.

Must conform to the regular expression `^[0-9]{10}$`
parameters.name: partnershipUtr

parameters.description: Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used.
parameters.name: Accept

parameters.description: An OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token with the *read:self-assessment* scope.
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Only in sandbox environment. See Test Data table for all header values.
parameters.name: Gov-Test-Scenario

submittedOn.description: The date and time of the partner income submission, in the format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ`

partnershipUtr.description: A Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) for the partnership. If you are a partner in a foreign partnership, you will not have a partnership reference, so submit your personal UTR.

partnershipName.description: The name of the partnership. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

startDate.description:
The date the individual joined the partnership during the tax year.

Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

endDate.description:
The date the individual left the partnership during the tax year.

Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

cashBasis.description: Indicates whether the partnership used cash basis (money actually received and paid out) to calculate its trading and professional income and expenses.

partnershipTrades.description: An array containing details of the partnership's trades.

tradeDescription.description: A description of the partnership trade or profession. This description is unique for each trade reported. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

tradingOrProfessionalProfits.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional profits.

shareOfProfitOrLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional profit or loss. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

basisAdjustment.description: If your basis period is not the same as your accounting period, enter the adjustment needed to arrive at the profit or loss for the basis period. If the adjustment needs to be taken off the profit figure, this should be negative. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

accountingAdjustment.description: The adjustment for change of accounting practice. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignTaxClaimedDeduction.description: The foreign tax claimed as deduction only if Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedProfit.description: The individual's share of the partnership's profit of the year, after all statutory adjustments have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

transitionProfitArisingThisYear.description: The amount of transition profit treated as arising in the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForwardTransitionProfit.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's amount of transition profit. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForwardAdjustedProfit.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's adjusted profit. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

profitAfterBroughtForwardLosses.description: The taxable profit remaining after deducting losses brought forward from earlier years, excluding the amount of transition profit treated as arising in the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherBusinessIncome.description: Any other business income received as a partner that was not included in the partnership accounts. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from the partnership's business for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

tradingOrProfessionalLosses.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's trading or professional losses.

adjustedLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's loss of the year, after all statutory adjustments have been applied. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

currentYearLossAppliedToGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's loss set off against the individual's other income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesCarriedBack.description: The amount of loss to be carried back to previous years and set off against income or capital gains. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

nationalInsuranceContributions.description: Object containing details of Class 2 and Class 4 National Insurance contributions (NICs).

voluntaryClass2Nics.description: Indicate whether the individual wants to pay Class 2 NICs voluntarily to protect entitlement to certain benefits if profits are below the Small Profits Threshold.

class4Exemption.description: Indicate whether the individual is exempt from paying Class 4 NICs.

adjustmentToProfitsForClass4.description: The adjustment to the individual's profits specifically used to calculate Class 4 NICs. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

untaxedSavingsIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's untaxed savings income and related adjustments.

shareOfUkUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The individual's share of UK untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

untaxedSavingsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to UK untaxed savings income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedUkSavingsIncome.description: The total adjusted UK savings income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfForeignUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The individual's share of foreign untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignUntaxedSavingsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to foreign untaxed savings income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

adjustedForeignSavingsIncome.description: The total adjusted foreign savings income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalUntaxedSavingsIncome.description: The total amount of untaxed savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

ukPropertyIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's UK property income and related adjustments.

shareOfProfitOrLoss.description: The individual's share of the partnership's UK property profit or loss. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

profitOrLossAdjustment.description: The adjustment to UK property profit or loss, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of UK property losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's profits. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

currentYearLossAppliedToGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's UK property loss set off against the individual's other income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of UK property losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from the UK property business for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCosts.description: The individual's share of the partnership's residential property finance costs for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCostsBroughtFo.description: The unused residential property finance costs brought forward from earlier years. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's other untaxed UK income and related adjustments.

shareOfOtherUntaxedUkIncome.description: The individual's share of other untaxed UK income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to other untaxed UK income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's other untaxed UK income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfLoss.description: The individual's share of loss from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedUkIncomeLossAdjustment.description: The adjustment to the individual's share of loss from other untaxed UK income for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of other untaxed UK income losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

offshoreFundsIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's income from offshore funds and related adjustments.

shareOfOffshoreFundsIncome.description: The individual's share of income from offshore funds. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

offshoreFundsIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to income from offshore funds, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableIncome.description: The individual's share of total taxable income from offshore funds for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's other untaxed foreign income and related adjustments.

shareOfOtherUntaxedForeignIncome.description: The individual's share of other untaxed foreign income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncomeAdjustment.description: The adjustment to other untaxed foreign income, including any adjustment for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The amount of losses brought forward from earlier years set off against the tax year's other untaxed foreign income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The total amount of foreign tax deducted where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxableProfit.description: The individual's share of total taxable profit from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfLoss.description: The individual's share of loss from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherUntaxedForeignIncomeLossesAdjustmen.description: The adjustment to the individual's share of loss from other untaxed foreign income for the tax year. The value must be between -99999999999.99 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of other untaxed foreign income losses to carry forward after all other set-offs, including unused losses brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCosts.description: The individual's share of the partnership's residential property finance costs for the tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialPropertyFinanceCostsBroughtFo.description: The unused residential property finance costs brought forward from earlier years. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalUntaxedIncomeExcludingSavings.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's total untaxed income, excluding savings income.

shareOfTotalUntaxedIncomeExcludingSaving.description: The individual's share of the partnership's total untaxed income, excluding savings income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxedIncomeAndDividendIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's dividend income and taxed income.

shareOfDividendIncome.description: The individual's share of dividend income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

dividendIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from dividend income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalDividendIncome.description: The total amount of dividend income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxedIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from taxed income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalTaxedIncome.description: The total amount of taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfOtherTaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of other taxed income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

otherTaxedIncomeForeignTaxTakenOff.description: The amount of foreign tax deducted from other taxed income where Foreign Tax Credit Relief is not being claimed. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

totalTaxedAndUntaxedIncome.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's total taxed and untaxed income.

shareOfTotalTaxedAndUntaxedIncome.description: The individual's share of the total taxed and untaxed income from the partnership. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxPaidAndDeductions.description: Object containing details of the individual's share of the partnership's tax paid and deductions.

shareOfIncomeTaxTakenOffPartnershipIncom.description: The individual's share of income tax deducted from partnership income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfCisDeductionsByContractors.description: The individual's share of Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) deductions made by contractors. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTaxTakenOffTradingIncome.description: The individual's share of any tax deducted from trading income (excluding CIS deductions). The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

shareOfTotalTaxTakenOff.description: The individual's share of total tax deducted. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.
